verdict.rationale: Exa has a docs reference section with API guides, and code examples are surfaced in a few places: a tool that generates a tested integration snippet for your stack (exa-docs-11), copy-paste SDK examples (exa-gh-3, exa-gh-9), and a 'Get Code' cURL export in the product UI. That 'Get Code' export was reported by a hands-on user as wrong (exa-comm-4), and no OpenAPI spec was found at the standard paths (exa-probe-3). missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it/playground API reference, runnable in-browser request examples, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent confirmation that the examples run correctly.
